author: Inside Edition
description: Getting a case of the giggles that just won't stop happens to the best of us. But imagine it happening while you're on live TV! Patrick Osborn, a meteorologist with WABI-TV in Bangor, Maine doesn't need to imagine it, because it actually happened to him during a recent broadcast. The chortling weatherman explains to Inside Edition's Alison Hall what caused him to start laughing, and why he just couldn't stop.
title: Weatherman Can't Stop Laughing During Live Broadcast

author: Inside Edition
description: Through the ups and downs of her life, Dolly Parton had one great love: her husband of 59 years, Carl Dean. Dolly told Johnny Carson that the two met in Nashville at a laundromat on the first day she moved to the country music capital. Dean died in March of 2025, at the age of 82. His death is reported to have affected Dolly greatly, and now the country music icon has followed him. Dolly Parton died today at the age of 80.
title: Dolly Parton’s Great Love Was Her Husband Carl

author: Inside Edition
description: Despite her recent well-publicized battles with health problems, the news that the legendary Dolly Parton died today came as a shock. From her humble beginnings in the Smoky Mountains of Tennessee to becoming a national treasure and country music icon, Parton's genuine kindness always shined through. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian shares what we've learned about the beloved performer's final days.
title: Death Of Dolly Parton Comes As Shock

author: Inside Edition
description: One Illinois electrician had a particularly bad – and scary – day on the job. A.J. Gow was working on a gas station sign 130 feet in the air when he ended up getting trapped inside. Hours went by, and it got hotter and hotter. As Gow began to lose hope of ever being rescued, he recorded goodbye messages to his family. Thankfully, he is now safe and back at work, though he says he's going to stay inside the lift bucket from now on. Inside Edition's Justin Finch reports.
title: Worker Trapped In Sign Records Goodbye Messages To His Family

author: Inside Edition
description:
Josh Collette broke his neck when he jumped into the ocean to save two kids from a California rip tide. Since the hero dad is now paralyzed and unable to talk, his wife is staying close by his hospital bedside, telling his story by lipreading his words. She spoke with Inside Edition's Jim Moret. Family members have started a GoFundMe account to help Josh move to a rehab facility specializing in spinal injuries. For more information, please visit:
https://www.gofundme.com/f/support-josh-collette
title: Hero Dad Breaks Neck Saving Kids From Rip Tide

author: Inside Edition
description: There were rebuttals today at the Lindsay Clancy trial, as millions of people waited on the edge of their seats for the case to go to the jury. But there's another woman in the courtroom getting attention: a reporter for Vanity Fair, who is going viral for smirking and winking. Her behavior is leading many to ask, "What's so funny?" Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports from the courthouse in Massachusetts.
title: Who Is The Woman Smirking At The Lindsay Clancy Trial?

author: Inside Edition
description: Country music legend Dolly Parton has died. She was 80 years old. Her nephew reported the news on her official Instagram account. Dolly Parton revealed days earlier that her health was declining and had been since the passing of her husband in March 2025. However she claimed to still be working and said she would continue until she couldn't any longer. Dolly Rebecca Parton Dean was a Tennessee native, born in Pittman Center in 1946.
title: Legendary Musician Dolly Parton Dead At 80

author: Inside Edition
description: Is there such a thing as too much cheese? Not for Sarah Kaufmann, the self-proclaimed Cheese Lady. She has a talent for bringing cheese to life. Her latest creation is at the Tennessee State Fair where she's carving 500 pounds of cheddar into a sculpture that represents the state's culture and heritage for America's 250th birthday celebration. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Sculptor Carves Tennessee's History Into 500-Pound Block Of Cheese
